shapeSummary: Flat 28.5 x 15.5 mm potted/heat-shrink ESC body with a round 9.7 mm spacer boss at one end (5.6 mm tall) with a 4 mm through hole along Z, joined by a thin PCB tab. Overall about 40.3 x 15.5 x 6.6 mm (X length, Y width with bottom at Y=0, Z thickness). Wires and connectors are omitted.
warnings: Body thickness (about 4.5 mm), z offsets, spacer diameter (about 9.7 mm) and tab thickness are estimated from the drawing.
Wires, connectors (XT30, bullet, TJC8), the LED and the logo are omitted.
The analysis lists the hole at y=0, but it is placed at the body mid-width (y=7.75) because the bottom of the part sits at Y=0.
Edges are sharp; the heat-shrink taper at the body ends is not modeled.
cadquery:
bw=15.5
yc=bw/2
x0=-20.15
body_x0=x0+40.3-28.5
# heat-shrink PCB body (z -1.2..3.3)
body=cq.Workplane('XY').box(28.5,bw,4.5,centered=False).translate((body_x0,0,-1.2))
# round spacer at tab end (z -3.3..2.3, height 5.6)
spacer=cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=-3.3).center(-15.3,yc).circle(4.85).extrude(5.6)
# PCB tab bridging spacer and body
tab=cq.Workplane('XY').box(body_x0+0.5+15.3,9.7,1.6,centered=False).translate((-15.3,yc-4.85,0.7))
part=body.union(spacer).union(tab)
hole=cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=-4).center(-15.3,yc).circle(2).extrude(9)
part=part.cut(hole)
